description: This file defines the SystemConfigurationHelper class which provides methods to gather system environment details such as OS info, PHP version, server info, MySQL version, and application version for OrangeHRM system. It includes functions to return this info as arrays or JSON, and interacts with external components like Doctrine ORM and Config.

classes.name: SystemConfigurationHelper
classes.description: Utility class for retrieving system environment details related to the server, PHP, MySQL, and OrangeHRM version.

methods.name: getSystemDetailsAsArray
methods.description: Returns an array containing OS, PHP, MySQL, server, and OHRM details.

methods.name: getOsDetails
methods.description: Retrieves details about the server OS environment.

methods.name: getServerDetails
methods.description: Returns the server software information from the $_SERVER superglobal.

methods.name: getMySqlDetails
methods.description: Returns details related to MySQL server, including server version.

methods.name: getSystemDetailsAsJson
methods.description: Serializes system details array into JSON format.

methods.name: getMySqlServerVersion
methods.description: Fetches the version of the MySQL server via Doctrine ORM connection.
